title: Troubleshooting | ContextMint Support
description: Fix common ContextMint problems — install, Engine, Ollama, extension, indexing, chat, image evidence, ARGUS, Context Lens, patches, cloud, and diagnostics.
heading: Troubleshooting
leadHtml: Symptom → likely cause → what to do. For concepts and workflows, see user documentation. Quick Q&A: FAQ.

groups.title: Install & first run
groups.noteHtml: Installing now? Use the dedicated installation support section first — it is the primary guide for setup issues.

items.q: Engine installs but tray icon never appears
items.cause: App started minimized or OS blocked startup.
items.fix: Check system tray overflow (^) on Windows. Relaunch Engine from Start menu. On Linux, confirm tray applet is running.

items.q: Extension installed but no ContextMint activity bar icon
items.cause: Extension disabled, wrong VS Code profile, or activation error.
items.fix: Extensions → enable ContextMint. Reload window. Check Output → “ContextMint” for activation errors.

items.q: First-run wizard loops or cannot find Python
items.cause: Dev layout vs packaged bundle path mismatch.
items.fix: Engine → Settings → set backend path to shipped bundle. Reinstall latest Engine build. For source dev, point pythonPath at project venv.

items.q: Status bar shows “server offline” / chat blocked
items.cause: API not listening on configured URL.
items.fix: Engine → Start all. Verify http://localhost:8000/api/health. Check firewall blocking loopback. If using shared server, verify serverUrl and TLS.

items.q: Server stuck on “Starting”
items.cause: Port 8000 in use, Python crash on boot, or zombie process.
items.fix: Engine → Logs. Stop all, kill stray python/contextmint processes, change port in Settings if needed, Start all again.

items.q: Health OK but extension never leaves Starting
items.cause: Stale readiness poll, wrong serverUrl, or index status timeout.
items.fix: Reload VS Code window. Confirm serverUrl has no trailing path typo. Engine → Server → restart server.

items.q: Redis / data layer warnings on Overview
items.cause: Optional Redis not running (some enterprise configs).
items.fix: For local-first pilot, often safe to ignore if chat works. For team server, start Redis per deployment guide or disable Redis-dependent features in server config.

items.q: Phase shows Limited — Ollama offline
items.cause: Ollama not running or wrong URL.
items.fix: Engine → Ollama → Start / Restart. Install Ollama if missing. Default URL http://localhost:11434.

items.q: Chat streams empty or “model not found”
items.cause: Chat model not pulled in Ollama.
items.fix: Engine → Models → pull default chat model. Match model name in server defaults.

items.q: Indexing very slow or embed errors
items.cause: Missing embed model, GPU/CPU overload, or disk pressure.
items.fix: Pull embed model in Models tab. Reduce concurrent indexing if tunable. Exclude large binary dirs via ignore rules.

items.q: First answer after restart is very slow
items.cause: Cold model load in Ollama.
items.fix: Expected once per restart. Server runs background warmup; send a short ping message to load model before important queries.

items.q: Wrong workspace / no retrieval for my repo
items.cause: Multi-root workspace, unregistered folder, or path mismatch on shared server.
items.fix: Open the repo root folder. Engine → Indexing → confirm workspace listed. Enterprise: paths on server must match VS Code folder paths.

items.q: Remote SSH — extension cannot reach server
items.cause: serverUrl points at localhost on remote host while browser test uses local machine.
items.fix: Run Engine on SSH host or use team serverUrl reachable from remote extension host. Port-forward 8000 if required.

items.q: enterpriseMode / auth failures (401)
items.cause: OIDC token missing or expired.
items.fix: Re-authenticate per org SSO flow. Confirm oidcProviderId matches server. Check server audit for auth errors.

items.q: Indexing stuck at 0% or never finishes
items.cause: Permission errors, huge repo, or crashed background task.
items.fix: Engine → Indexing → view errors. Engine → Logs. Trigger manual reindex. Exclude node_modules, build artifacts via ignore config.

items.q: Chat says “no repo matches” for known files
items.cause: File not indexed yet, wrong lane (Repo with empty index), or query mismatch.
items.fix: Open file in editor (priority index). Wait for indexing. Attach file explicitly. Try Hybrid lane. Use symbol-rich query for code lookups.

items.q: Reindex after every small change
items.cause: Embed model changed, hash cache cleared, or watcher storm.
items.fix: Stabilize embed model in Models tab. Check logs for repeated full reindex triggers. Pause bulk file operations during initial index.

items.q: Readiness Error phase
items.cause: Indexer exception, corrupt local store, or disk full.
items.fix: Engine → Indexing error detail. Free disk space. Last resort: clear workspace index data and full reindex (backup first).

items.q: Planning question gets “I don’t have context” in Repo lane
items.cause: Expected — Repo lane refuses to speculate without evidence.
items.fix: Switch to Work lane or accept Use Work lane banner. Attach notes or activate a session pack.

items.q: Work lane still feels empty
items.cause: No packs built, no attachments.
items.fix: Build session/repo packs. Attach markdown or spec files. Paste key context as attachment.

items.q: Stream hangs — spinner never ends
items.cause: Ollama hang, cloud timeout, or SSE disconnect.
items.fix: Click Cancel (send button). Restart Ollama. Check Logs. Reduce context size / attachment count. Retry with Local model only.

items.q: Cloud routing fails but local works
items.cause: Invalid API key, provider outage, or cloudEnabled false.
items.fix: Re-run Configure Cloud API Key. Enable contextmint.cloudEnabled. Check provider status. Inspect routing badge for tier used.

items.q: Paste does nothing / no image chip
items.cause: Image attachments disabled, wrong format, or file too large.
items.fix: Enable contextmint.chat.imageAttachmentsEnabled. Use PNG, JPEG, or WebP — not SVG. Max 5 MiB per image. Check Output → ContextMint for validation errors.

items.q: Lens shows needs_vlm / “Pull a vision model”
items.cause: No Ollama vision model installed.
items.fix: Engine → Models → pull moondream (small) or llava. Restart Ollama if pull succeeded but route still fails. Cloud API keys do not replace a local VLM unless you explicitly select cloud vision.

items.q: Image question answered without using the screenshot
items.cause: Text-only model selected, or vision route fell back after VLM error.
items.fix: Confirm Lens shows local or cloud vision route before send. Pull/update vision model. Check Engine → Logs for multimodal errors. Retry with Local model + installed VLM.

items.q: Vision answer very slow or OOM
items.cause: Large VLM on limited VRAM; chat + vision models competing.
items.fix: Use moondream on laptops. Let chat model unload between turns if operator enabled unload-before-vision. Reduce attached image count. Close other GPU-heavy apps.

items.q: Run visual audit disabled or no findings
items.cause: ARGUS disabled on server, audit running during stream, or VLM returned empty JSON.
items.fix: Wait for chat stream to finish. Confirm local VLM installed. Retry with a clear UI screenshot. Check argus.enabled on server defaults. Engine → Logs for /api/argus/audit errors.

items.q: Sandbox audit shows deps_unavailable
items.cause: Preview worktree could not install dependencies within timeout.
items.fix: Open sandbox worktree manually and fix npm ci / install errors. Increase argus.deps_install_timeout_sec on server if repo is large. Use paste audit path when sandbox bootstrap is not required.

items.q: Expected local route but badge shows cloud
items.cause: You explicitly selected a cloud vision model in compose.
items.fix: Select Local or Auto with local VLM installed. Attaching images alone should not force cloud — if it does, file a bug with support bundle and vision route from Lens.

items.q: Context Lens never appears
items.cause: lensPreviewEnabled off and first-N sends exhausted.
items.fix: Enable contextmint.trust.lensPreviewEnabled. Toggle preview from compose or trust settings.

items.q: @pack:name not found
items.cause: Pack not built or wrong name in manifest.
items.fix: Packs panel → Scan & learn. Verify manifest.yaml name matches @pack reference.

items.q: Stale pack banner every session
items.cause: Sources changed faster than auto-sync.
items.fix: Rebuild pack. Enable autoSync with appropriate debounce. Commit pack sources if intentional.

items.q: Propose patch button missing or disabled
items.cause: Not in Agent mode, readiness blocked, or sandbox policy.
items.fix: Switch to Agent mode. Confirm Ready/Limited/Indexing phase. Check sandbox.enabled settings.

items.q: Apply failed / partial write
items.cause: File permissions, git conflict, or path outside workspace.
items.fix: Review diff in patch preview. Ensure files writable. Use git to revert. Check Output for apply errors.

items.q: Governance drawer empty
items.cause: No quality scan run for workspace.
items.fix: Engine → Quality → run scan. Wait for completion. Retry chat with governance preview enabled.

items.q: Shared server — workspace path not found
items.cause: Server indexes /data/repos/foo but VS Code opens C:\foo.
items.fix: Align paths via Remote SSH same absolute path or server-side path mapping. Re-register workspace on server.

items.q: TLS / certificate errors to team API
items.cause: Corporate MITM or self-signed cert not trusted.
items.fix: Install org root CA on dev machine. Use valid internal cert on API ingress. Temporary dev-only: trust proxy settings per IT policy.

items.q: High CPU during indexing + chat
items.cause: Embed batch + chat inference competing on same machine.
items.fix: Let initial index complete. Use a smaller chat model. On contested shared Ollama hosts set server inline.pause_mode to shared_runtime (extension contextmint.inline.pauseWhileIndexing only tightens further). Schedule large reindex off-hours.

items.q: Context Lens slow on large repos
items.cause: Many chunks retrieved before cap.
items.fix: Narrow question. Attach specific files. Exclude irrelevant chunks in lens. Tune max context settings on server if operator.

collect.q: What to collect before contacting support
steps: OS version and VS Code version
Steps to reproduce, readiness phase, context lane used
Relevant redacted log lines from Engine → Logs

escalation.bodyHtml: Pilot cohorts get direct engineering channel. See Design Partners or your onboarding contact.
